blocks:site-header.title: Site Header
blocks:site-header.description: The canonical varunUI marketing header with logo-home behavior, five stable destinations, active route state, sign-in link, one primary action, and the responsive Navbar interaction contract.

blocks:decision-log.title: Decision Log
blocks:decision-log.description: A specialized diagnostic table for recent decisions, owners, review status, and dates. The Block owns the domain schema while Data Table keeps search, filters, density, export, fullscreen, visibility, and resizing behavior.

blocks:services.title: Service Grid
blocks:services.description: Centered header, three-column grid of capability cards, and an optional CTA with bottom text. Each card leads with a Phosphor icon.

blocks:goal-progress.title: Goal Progress
blocks:goal-progress.description: A flat ruled dashboard sequence with concrete release goals, accessible progress meters, visible counts, and one route to unresolved checks.

blocks:process-steps.title: Process Steps
blocks:process-steps.description: A responsive ruled sequence of numbered steps with one hierarchy and no decorative card containers.

blocks:contact-methods.title: Contact Methods
blocks:contact-methods.description: Three pink fully linked contact cards for support, a scoped call, and self-service help, with one shared hierarchy and restrained directional motion.

blocks:command-search-spotlight.title: Global Search
blocks:command-search-spotlight.description: A split product-search region with one Marker-led promise and a functional search surface showing compact, typed results.

blocks:active-sessions-manager.title: Active Sessions Manager
blocks:active-sessions-manager.description: Security settings card showing active login sessions with device icons, browser info, location, and sign-out controls.

blocks:product-preview.title: Product Preview
blocks:product-preview.description: A blue feature split pairing a focused pitch with a real Browser Frame composition of App Shell, Sidebar Nav, Sidebar Profile, Metric Trends, and Line Chart. No fake screenshot geometry.

blocks:integration-gallery.title: Integration Gallery
blocks:integration-gallery.description: A blue Marker-led integration directory with one partitioned connector grid, concrete handoff descriptions, and no remote logo dependency.

blocks:current-plan-summary.title: Current Plan Summary
blocks:current-plan-summary.description: Subscription management card showing current plan details, pricing, included features, renewal date, and status badges with actions to change or cancel.

blocks:invoice-history.title: Invoice History Table
blocks:invoice-history.description: Billing history table showing invoices with date, description, amount, payment status badges, and download buttons.

blocks:outcome-stats.title: System Facts
blocks:outcome-stats.description: Four stable system constraints shown as static facts in a yellow Marker-led ruled grid. Use for real product facts, not animated vanity counts.

blocks:role-use-cases.title: Role Use Cases
blocks:role-use-cases.description: Three blue product-explanation cards under a ruled introduction, each with one role, a concrete outcome, and an Link.
